definition: to delay something to a later time
description: A village cricket ground under a huge black storm cloud. Ground staff in navy rain jackets pull a large white cover across the wet pitch, leaning hard into it. Two cricket players in white walk off the wet grass: a young woman carrying her helmet and smiling, and a young man lifting his helmet and looking up at the sky. Puddles lie on the field, a boundary rope runs across the grass, and spectators with umbrellas stand by a white pavilion.

taps.target: the woman in the rain jacket
